technique_name: Describe a current application of natural language processing
description: Natural language processing is currently used in a variety of applications, including virtual assistants and chatbots, text-based search, automatic summarization and translation, and language generation. Virtual assistants and chatbots use NLP to interpret user input and create natural, conversational responses. Text-based search utilizes NLP to interpret user queries and return relevant results.
